subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw officially support FxTwitter as an optional third-party public-read provider, and if so, what narrow capability and endpoint-safety contract should its first release guarantee?
rationale: The architecture can accommodate an adapter, but code inspection cannot decide whether the repository should own this provider's privacy disclosure, API compatibility, operational reliability, configuration, and support burden.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow MVP
options.body: Approve explicit post, thread, profile, and public-search reads with no automatic fallback, strict capability errors, canonical persistence, and a documented endpoint-security policy.

options.title: Prototype lookup only
options.body: Limit the first supported surface to post and thread lookup until response stability, attribution, and live-service behavior are proven.

options.title: Defer provider adoption
options.body: Keep bird and xurl as the supported live transports until a maintainer commits to FxTwitter ownership and operational support.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Approve explicit post, thread, profile, and public-search reads with no automatic fallback, strict capability errors, canonical persistence, and a documented endpoint-security policy.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md names Peter Steinberger as product owner, and steipete has already engaged with this issue.
